title: Director of Operations
text:
**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading and optimizing all aspects of business unit operations (water, wastewater and natural gas) to achieve exceptional safety performance, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, workforce development, and profitable growth. This role serves as a key member of the leadership team, translating strategic objectives into operational execution while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation. The role develops leaders, drives operational consistency, and champions the company's values while positioning the organization for long-term success.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Direct supervision of 3-4 managers and provide leadership in support of subordinate managers within a 90+ employee business.

**Hiring Requirements:**

* Four years Technical/Business Administration degree or equivalent, plus extensive (10+ years) experience in the utility industry or equivalent.
* 5+ years of experience in a leadership position responsible for directing and coordinating staff, subcontractors and consultants, and making organizational decisions.
* Excellent financial, business development, customer interaction, and sales skills, with the ability to manage profit and loss responsibilities.
* Thorough understanding of contract administration, specifications, and applicable laws
* Experience in developing strategic plans, leading initiatives, and managing multiple complex priorities to achieve results within demanding timeframes and budgets.
* Excellent writing and presentation, communication (verbal and written) skills required. Computer proficiency with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven track record of excellent customer service, strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving ability, and the capability to engage with prospective customers at the leadership level.
* OSHA 10 General Industry Certification, or ability to obtain during pre-employment (company provided online training).
* Pass pre-employment drug screen and physical.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a valid unrestricted Driver's License.

For more than 40 years, WhiteWater has been managing, operating, and maintaining municipal and private water and wastewater facilities throughout the northeast with pride and professionalism. We are a subsidiary of R.H. White, an award-winning construction services and solutions company, that has been in business since 1923.

WhiteWater was named 2019 Utility of the Year by the New England Water Works Association and is passionately focused on safely performing great work with our people for our clients. Help us fulfill our mission of protecting public health and (the environment) our most precious natural resource - water.

WhiteWater is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, we encourage all qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
